general_information.Description: This course aims to provide technical knowledge and skills for student. Student will learn about web technologies such as HTML, CSS and Javascript. They have to practice to create website from the simple to a complex client-size or front-end web application. This is the advanced course of Web Design course, so student will continue their work in the end of the first course, and make an empirical version of last graphical design product in its project by applying web technologies. Beside the technologies, in this course student will learn about web design principles and approaches such as responsive web, and also understand techniques and tools to implement a website in a development processes. After this course, student can completely create a web themes includes images, icons, css(s), html(s) and javascript(s).
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attendance >=80% - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.fap.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment. - Computer with graphic softwares for creating website layouts (Photoshop/ Illustrator/ Sketch, ...) and web development tool (Dreamweaver/ Sublime Text, ...) - Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher 1 day after the course.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain the reasons of using grid systems in web design
Apply grid systems to the web site interfaces in order to develop responsive web site
List different image formats in web design
Select appropriate image formats in web design
List basic HTML tags for creating web themes (index page, content page, contact page, ...)
List basic CSS for styling web elements (font, paragraph, heading, navigation, link, button, form, ...)
Develop the static website layouts to HTML pages (front-end phase)
Design interaction for the website by using CSS and JavaScript Library (navigation, link HTML pages, gallery slide show, ...)
Add media files (video, audio, ...) to the web site
Apply Bootstrap to creating responsive, mobile-first web sites
Test front-end version of the web site and fix errors
Students have a proficient in presentation and teamworks. Having a professional working style.

assessments.Grading Guide: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. Teacher give marks on student's student's Class participation and preparation only after the Portfolio submission.
Amount of work on Web Interface (60%) and Presentation (25%), and ability to explain and answer questions from evaluator (15%)
assessments.Note: Student must deliver portfolio in time and present at class
